I received a claim acknowledgement at 12:56 PM, but despite multiple follow-ups, no approval was provided even by 8 PM. When I finally reached customer care, I was told that the claim was pending because they required the last 4 years of policy documents. Shockingly, there was no prior communication about this requirement — not an email, SMS, or call.

To make matters worse, the representative bluntly stated, “claim approve nahi hoga,” as if it was the customer’s fault. It is completely unreasonable to expect a customer to keep 4 years of past policies handy during a medical emergency.

This has been the worst experience I’ve had with any TPA — unresponsive, unprofessional, and lacking empathy. Strongly advise others to think twice before trusting your health insurance needs to them
